problem_statement: Investigators need to reconcile payment status, client notes, exception codes, and policy constraints before they can resolve delayed payments.
agent_role: Assembles the investigation timeline, flags missing data, recommends the next operational step, and requests human approval for client-facing updates.

problem_statement: Service requests move across custody, trust, liquidity, and reporting teams without a consistent routing rationale or client-ready status summary.
agent_role: Classifies request intent, selects the next service queue, drafts internal context, and keeps the client-service owner in control.

problem_statement: Covenant exceptions arrive through fragmented notes, spreadsheets, and inbox threads, which slows credit follow-up and makes escalation evidence inconsistent.
agent_role: Summarizes exceptions, retrieves covenant context, drafts follow-up questions, and routes unresolved items to credit review.

problem_statement: Case packets require transaction context, merchant evidence, customer notes, and policy checks before a specialist can act.
agent_role: Builds a dispute packet, flags contradictory evidence, suggests the next case action, and requires specialist approval before submission.

problem_statement: New client packets often need follow-up because forms, identity evidence, risk preferences, and account-opening notes are reviewed in separate systems.
agent_role: Checks packet completeness, highlights missing evidence, drafts advisor follow-up language, and sends exceptions to human review.

problem_statement: Refresh packets require repeated document checks, ownership questions, and policy evidence before a reviewer can approve the case.
agent_role: Prepares an evidence checklist, extracts document signals, drafts reviewer notes, and blocks completion when critical evidence is absent.

problem_statement: Relationship managers need a concise account context brief before client outreach, but signals are spread across service, credit, treasury, and pipeline systems.
agent_role: Synthesizes account signals, highlights open risks, recommends next questions, and blocks unsupported product recommendations.

problem_statement: Deal documents and amendments require quick summarization, obligation tracking, and review routing without weakening legal control.
agent_role: Creates structured summaries, extracts obligations, links source passages, and routes low-confidence clauses to legal review.
